content.title: Complete a successful funding operation for standard_user
content.intent: Prove that a supported authenticated user can initiate and complete funding with a valid amount, increase the targeted balance by the committed amount, and see the operation reflected in transaction history where that surface is exposed.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning for a representative valid funding input and state/flow for the authenticated commit path. Auth-gated and web-form profiles applied because the feature is browser-based and available only after authentication. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because money, auth, and data-loss apply; no covering array was needed because this scenario uses one representative allowed combination rather than sweeping multiple independent inputs. Budget: no ceiling set, so this scenario was kept.

parameters.amount_class: valid monetary amount accepted by the live funding surface
parameters.history_expectation: only when transaction/activity history is exposed for the funded account
